## Outcome
What user-facing or developer-facing behavior changes?

## Evidence and tests
- [ ] Deterministic tests or explanation of why none needed
- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] Sources, date/units, and assumptions explicit when relevant
- [ ] Documentation and examples updated

## Safety and licensing
- [ ] No private portfolio data, credentials or personal information
- [ ] No unlicensed vendor data or restricted research content
- [ ] No overclaiming of returns or recommendations

## Design
- [ ] Follows dependency rules or documents a justified ADR
